name: Whisperio – AI Dictation
subtitle: Voice Typing, Your Own API Key
promotionalText: Dictation for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. On-device by default, or bring your own AI key. No account, no subscription, no Whisperio server.
description:
Whisperio turns your voice into clean, formatted text on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.

No account. No subscription. No Whisperio server. The app is free, and by default your speech is recognized on your device. If you choose a cloud engine, you pay that provider directly.

DICTATE ANYWHERE
Start dictation from the Home Screen widget, Control Center, Back Tap, Apple Watch or the system-wide Whisperio keyboard. With the Whisperio keyboard, text goes straight into the field you're typing in; the other triggers copy it, ready to paste into Messages, Notes, Slack, email or anywhere else.

ON-DEVICE BY DEFAULT
Out of the box, Whisperio uses Apple's speech recognition on your device. Apple's servers are used only if you turn on Apple online speech in the app's settings (for example, when your language isn't available on-device). You can also download a local model and transcribe on your device.

YOUR PROVIDERS, YOUR KEYS
Want a cloud engine? Bring your own API key for OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Groq, Mistral or Replicate, or point Whisperio at your own server that speaks the OpenAI API. No markup: you pay the provider directly at its own rates, and Whisperio shows an estimate based on the provider's list price. Keys stay in your device's Keychain and are sent only to their own provider.

AI CLEANUP, ON YOUR TERMS
Dictated text pastes instantly. When you want it polished, run AI cleanup on demand: fix grammar, apply a custom instruction or use a saved template. The AI never slows down the dictation itself.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Whisperio never phones home to a Whisperio server and has no analytics or tracking. Audio goes straight from your device to the transcription provider you chose, or nowhere at all when you transcribe on-device. Cloud providers process your audio under their own terms, so pick the one you trust.

STAYS IN SYNC
Your dictation history syncs between your iPhone and iPad through your private iCloud database (transcripts and metadata, no audio), or stays on this device only if you prefer. It is organized into a searchable journal with categories (Work, Personal, Ideas, Messages, Code, To-do) and an optional AI daily digest.

QUICK AND COMFORTABLE
- System-wide keyboard with word suggestions
- Home Screen widget and Apple Watch trigger
- Personal dictionary
- Group conversation mode with speaker labels (with cloud engines that support it)

Whisperio is source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial license, so you can inspect exactly how it handles your voice and your keys.

Privacy Policy: https://whisperio.danielkasprzyk.com/privacy.html
